_meta.counts_are: measured (extracted from a captured file) - every count names the file it came from

CA.association: California Interscholastic Federation (CIF) - state office + 10 sections

enumeration.alternate_method: Presto widget flat name list per section: https://www.cif<section>home.org/widget/school/directory

coach_fields.source: none located at state or section level in this lane
coach_fields.note: CIF state publishes an Athletic Administrators Summit and an Athletic Director eligibility workshop, but no machine-readable AD/coach directory

CA.sanctioned_timing_provider: not published by CIF state; officials/registration via Arbiter (https://cif.arbitersports.com/front/111820/site)
gaps: CIF-SS /directory/ is labelled `School Directory` but the static HTML contains no school list - it is SearchWP client-side search. Count not measured.
SJS /member-schools returns 0 school-name strings in static HTML. Count not measured.
CCS /schools/ccs_directory returns 1 school-name string in static HTML. Count not measured.
Oakland Section has no CIF-hosted directory; census is the only CA-wide enumerator that covers it.
The census file contains one row whose `CIF Section` value is the literal string `4570` instead of a section name.

secondary_school_count.note: 2 more than the member list - the participation workbook includes schools absent from the full-members list

enumeration.robots_constraint: osaa.org/robots.txt Disallows /teams/, /contests/, /brackets/, /forms/, /mobile/, /demo/, /dev/ - the school list is NOT under any of those, but per-school TEAM pages are (/teams/) and were therefore not fetched

coach_fields.caveat: `TBD` appears as a literal Head Coach value where the school has not named one

gaps: No OR state-level XC/TF coach directory with emails (only per-school pages)
TF participation is in the Spring workbook, not measured in this lane

lane_summary.note: school_counts_total is the arithmetic sum of six separately measured figures; no claim is made that the six sets are disjoint at the school level (a school cannot belong to two state associations, but CA's census counts one row per school name+city, so intra-state duplicates by name are possible)
